steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each placement is placed by its end date and any extension.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 placement ends within 14 days with no decision

findings.title: Placement ending within 14 days with no extension decision
findings.fix: Decide extend or end this week

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] placement-p101.md:12  Placement ending within 14 days with no extension decision.
       Fix: Decide extend or end this week.
[medium] placement-p104.md:19  Placement with no contract reference.
       Fix: Add the contract reference.
[low] contract-refs.csv:26  Extension with no approval.
       Fix: Get the approval.
Not checked: Whether the contractor is working.
pros: Checks a placement ending within 14 days with no extension decision, a placement with no contract reference, and an extension with no approval.
cons: Not checked: Whether the contractor is working.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-deployment-tracker skill on the records for this review.
